SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM destinations d JOIN categories c ON c.name = #{categoryName} LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id
LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_categories dc WHERE dc.destination_id = d.id AND dc.category_id = c.id ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM destinations d LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE d.season = #{season} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 AND TRIM(di.image_url) <> '' ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_categories dc JOIN categories c ON c.id = dc.category_id WHERE dc.destination_id = d.id AND c.name = #{categoryName} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 AND TRIM(di.image_url) <> '' ) ORDER BY (d.views + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.target_type = 'DESTINATION' AND b.target_id = d.id )) DESC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 AND TRIM(di.image_url) <> '' ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM ( SELECT dvd.destination_id, SUM(dvd.view_count) AS recent_views FROM destination_view_daily dvd WHERE dvd.view_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY dvd.destination_id ORDER BY recent_views DESC, dvd.destination_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent JOIN destinations d ON d.id = recent.destination_id LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id ORDER BY recent.recent_views DESC, recent.destination_id ASC

SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, pcc.id AS parent_region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM destinations d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dvd.destination_id, SUM(dvd.view_count) AS recent_views FROM destination_view_daily dvd WHERE dvd.view_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY dvd.destination_id ) recent ON recent.destination_id = d.id LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE d.season = #{season} ORDER BY COALESCE(recent.recent_views, 0) DESC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id = #{categoryId}
